title: Motion (Jurado – Soto-Martínez) relative to establishing an Environmental Justice and Advocacy Advisory Commission.
text:
[Council File 26-0906-S9]
Motion (Jurado – Soto-Martínez) relative to establishing an Environmental Justice and Advocacy Advisory Commission.
(This item was referred to Energy and Environment Committee and Civil Rights, Equity, Immigration, Aging, and Disability Committee)
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Council established an Environmental Justice and Advocacy Advisory Commission.

outcome.text: Civil Rights, Equity, Immigration, Aging, and Disability Committee approved item(s) (Aug 21, 2026); Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Aug 26, 2026)
